title: Atlas + ClickHouse
tagline: Declarative schema migrations via Atlas CLI against local ClickHouse.
description: Atlas (atlasgo.io) managing ClickHouse schema as code — the agent declares the desired schema in HCL/SQL and lets Atlas plan the migration. A second local ClickHouse is pre-provisioned as Atlas's --dev-url so diffs compute without docker-in-docker. Isolates 'does Atlas plan destructive ClickHouse migrations safely' from raw ClickHouse CLI skill (base-rt) and Moose's own migration planner (moose-*-migrations).
